subtitle: 交換回國後，寫信感謝寄宿家庭的照顧
task: You have just come home from a short exchange trip abroad, where you stayed with a host family. Write an email to thank them. Mention some special memories and explain how the trip helped you.
taskZh: 你剛結束短期出國交換回到台灣，交換期間住在寄宿家庭。寫一封 email 感謝他們：提到幾個特別的回憶，並說明這趟旅程對你的幫助。
focus: 過去式與現在完成式的使用

en: I hope you are both doing well! I arrived home in Hsinchu safely last Sunday, and I have finally recovered from the jet lag. I wanted to write and thank you for everything you did for me during my two weeks in Brisbane.

Before the trip, I was nervous about living with a family I had never met. However, you made me feel at home from the very first night. I still remember the barbecue in your backyard and the long walk along the beach. Thanks to our dinner conversations, my English improved much faster than I expected. I will also never forget how patiently you explained Australian slang to me!
I have sent you a small package with some pineapple cakes and a tea set from Taiwan. I hope you enjoy them. If you ever visit Taiwan, I would love to show you around.
zh: 希望你們都好！我上週日平安回到新竹了，時差也終於調過來了。我想寫信謝謝你們在我待在布里斯本的兩週裡為我做的一切。
出發前，我很緊張要和一個從沒見過面的家庭一起生活。不過，從第一個晚上起，你們就讓我覺得像在家一樣。我還記得在你們後院的烤肉，還有沿著海灘的長長散步。多虧了我們晚餐時的聊天，我的英文進步得比我預期的快很多。我也永遠不會忘記你們多麼有耐心地向我解釋澳洲俚語！
我寄了一個小包裹給你們，裡面有一些鳳梨酥和一組台灣茶具。希望你們會喜歡。如果你們有機會來台灣，我很想帶你們到處逛逛。
